rationale: The claim is covered under section 7 (Emergency Medical) of the wording: a sudden injury on 12 August 2026, inside the covered trip dates, treated the same day, with the itemized clinic bill and medical records required by section 5 of the claims manual on file. No exclusion applies — the records show no relevant medical history, no listed adventure sport was involved, and the treatment could not reasonably wait until home. Payout follows section 10: $380 clinic and X-ray plus $45 painkillers = $425, with no other-party payment to deduct, the First plan deductible of $0 and the $250,000 maximum nowhere near reached.
